title: a price history kept by a trigger, with a tstzrange saying when each price was true

steps.note: prices, plus a history table. the trigger closes the old version and opens a new one on every change. it reads its clock from app.clock, so this page's output is stable; in production it would be now().

steps.sql:
SET app.clock = '2026-03-01 00:00+00';
INSERT INTO prices VALUES ('TEA-01', 6.50)
steps.note: assam tea goes on sale on march 1 at 6.50.

steps.sql:
SET app.clock = '2026-03-12 00:00+00';
UPDATE prices SET price = 7.25 WHERE sku = 'TEA-01'

SET app.clock = '2026-03-20 00:00+00';
UPDATE prices SET price = 5.95 WHERE sku = 'TEA-01'

SET app.clock = '2026-04-01 00:00+00';
UPDATE prices SET price = 7.25 WHERE sku = 'TEA-01'
SELECT price, lower(valid)::date AS valid_from, upper(valid)::date AS valid_to FROM price_history ORDER BY lower(valid)
steps.note: the history: four versions, each valid from one change to the next. the last one is open-ended.

steps.sql: SELECT sku, price FROM price_history WHERE sku = 'TEA-01' AND valid @> '2026-03-05 12:00+00'::timestamptz
steps.note: as of march 5: the range that contains that instant.

steps.sql: SELECT sku, price FROM price_history WHERE sku = 'TEA-01' AND valid @> '2026-03-15 12:00+00'::timestamptz
SELECT sku, price FROM price_history WHERE sku = 'TEA-01' AND valid @> '2026-03-25 12:00+00'::timestamptz
SELECT sku, price FROM price_history WHERE sku = 'TEA-01' AND valid @> '2026-04-10 12:00+00'::timestamptz
steps.note: as of april 10, the open-ended version.
